_comment: SWDev: place this file at <project>/.claude/settings.json (create the .claude folder; merge if one exists). Permission stance: the PROJECT tree is fully editable without prompts (acceptEdits + allow Edit/Write ./**), the FRAMEWORK is readable without prompts (additionalDirectories + allow Read) and mechanically NON-editable (deny beats everything; //c/... = C:\\...). Common build commands are pre-approved in 'allow' - extend that list for your stack rather than answering prompts one by one. GIT (v0.16): agents may READ history (status, diff, log, show, blame...) and never WRITE it - commit, tag, push, reset, checkout, add... are denied here and by the bash approver; the owner commits by hand at WO closes (floor F3). Hooks wired: the PreToolUse guard on the edit tools AND on Bash (denies edits and shell writes to locked-tier Contract files and hard-stop paths per .swdev/guard.json, logs contract-delta events for notify-tier writes, fails CLOSED on a broken guard.json), the Bash auto-approver (DENIES shell writes to .md ledgers, writes under the framework, backslash paths outside quotes or inside inline scripts, and git writes; ALLOWS safe project-local commands incl. the session scratchpad and guard.json 'benign_roots' such as an SDK; everything else falls back to normal prompts), the telemetry hook (subagent launches with the model tier that actually runs, skill invocations, completions, session starts -> .swdev/log/telemetry.jsonl; never blocks), and the Stop reminder (progress.md discipline). If the framework lives elsewhere than C:/GitHub/AI/SWDev, update ALL paths. Requires python on PATH. Ledgers (tasks.md, progress.md, decisions.md, workorders/...) are edited with the Edit/Write tools only - never through the shell.
